description:
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Security Automation Engineer designs, builds, and operates the automation that lets Clearwater's security operations scale without scaling headcount at the same rate. This role owns the full lifecycle of automation development — from mapping a manual security workflow, to building the integration and logic that automates it, to monitoring that automation in production — across phishing triage, host isolation, user offboarding, alert enrichment, and ticket handling.
   

  

 This is a builder role for someone who thinks like both a security practitioner and a software engineer: comfortable reasoning about incident\-response logic and comfortable writing production\-quality code that other engineers can maintain. The Senior Security Automation Engineer partners closely with SOC, Incident Response, and IT teams to find automation opportunities, and is expected to bring judgment about where automation — including AI\-driven automation — helps versus where it introduces risk.
   

  

**Specific Job Responsibilities**
* 
+ Workflow Orchestration: Design automated playbooks for common security scenarios (e.g., phishing triage, host isolation, user offboarding) using code or logic flows.
+ API Integration: Build custom connectors to link disparate systems (e.g., SIEM, EDR, Ticketing Systems) via REST/gRPC APIs.
+ ChatOps: Develop bots for internal collaboration platforms (e.g., Slack/Teams) to enable self\-service security tasks.
+ AI\-Driven Triage: Implement Generative AI workflows to autonomously parse tickets, summarize alerts, and extract Indicators of Compromise (IoCs).


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Scripting \& Coding: Strong proficiency in Python or Golang with a focus on API interaction and data processing.
* Integration Patterns: Expert understanding of Webhooks, RESTful design, and authentication methods (OIDC/OAuth/API Keys).
* Operational Logic: Experience with SOAR concepts (Logic Apps, Serverless Functions, or Workflow Engines) to automate decision trees.
* Security Context: Understanding of the Incident Response lifecycle and standard data formats (JSON, YAML).


**Experience Required**
* 5–10 years of combined experience in security engineering, security operations/incident response, or software engineering with a security focus.
* 2\+ years specifically building security automation, SOAR playbooks, or equivalent orchestration solutions.
* Demonstrated experience integrating security tools (SIEM, EDR, ticketing/ITSM) via APIs in a production environment.


**Qualifications, Skills, \& Knowledge** 
  

  

* 
+ Strong proficiency in Python or Golang, with a focus on API interaction and data processing.
+ Expert understanding of integration patterns: webhooks, RESTful design, and authentication methods (OIDC/OAuth/API keys).
+ Practical experience with SOAR concepts — logic apps, serverless functions, or workflow engines — to automate decision trees.
+ Solid understanding of the incident\-response lifecycle and standard data formats (JSON, YAML).
+ Ability to reason about failure modes and edge cases in automated workflows, not just the happy path.
+ Clear written communication — this role documents its own work so others can rely on it.
+ Ability to Embrace Clearwater's CLEAR Core Values Commitment to Client Success, Lead with Accountability, Integrity \& Collaboration, Excellence in All That We Do, Advance Colleague Success, and Respect \& Transparency


**PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT EXPECTATIONS**
* Stay current on SOAR platforms, automation tooling, and applied generative\-AI techniques relevant to security operations.
* Contribute reusable components, internal documentation, and lessons learned back to the automation practice.
* Mentor other engineers on secure coding and automation design as the team grows.
* Participate in relevant security engineering communities, conferences, or working groups to bring outside ideas back to the team.


 The base salary range for this role is $35,000\-$45,000\.  At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.
   

  

**About Us**
 Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.

In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.
   

  

**About The Role**

This role combines test leadership, hands\-on technical expertise, and stakeholder collaboration, ensuring that products meet high quality, reliability, and performance standards.

* Strong expertise in Automation Testing and QA processes

* Automation Framework Development
* API Testing using C\# or relevant frameworks
* Performance Testing using JMeter
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools
* Strong database knowledge (SQL Server or equivalent)
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing


**With us you will be responsible for**
* Define and drive test strategy, test approach, and quality assurance processes for multiple products
* Lead test planning, estimation, scheduling, and execution across system testing, UAT, and releases
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage using risk\-based and data\-driven testing approaches
* Own test artifacts including test plans, test cases, test data, and test reports


**Quality Engineering \& Automation**
* Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks and solutions
* Drive AI\-first and automation\-first approach across UI, API, and performance testing
* Guide team in test design, reusable assets, and best engineering practices
* Continuously improve test efficiency, coverage, and defect detection capability


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Customer Focus**

* Understand customer business needs and propose effective testing approaches

**Team Leadership \& Mentoring**
* Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers and SDETs
* Guide team members in automation and manual testing practices
* Build capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, and continuous feedback
* Ensure effective team organization, planning, and delivery ownership


**Defect Management \& Continuous Improvement**
* Analyze defects and guide teams in root cause analysis and prevention strategies
* Provide actionable feedback to development teams to improve product quality
* Drive process improvements and best practices in line with Agile and DevOps models
* Support reproduction and analysis of complex/rare defects


**We expect you to have**
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in software testing / quality engineering
* At least 3–5 years of experience as Test Lead / Test Manager
* Proven experience in test design, execution, stakeholder collaboration, and team leadership

The end goal of the system is that all data must pass permission checks, quality validation, and PII sanitization before entering vector databases (for performing semantic searches) or for Large Language Model (LLM) training. NDH also enhances financial accountability, offering cost governance, resource optimization, and clear cloud metering and chargeback visibility. Moreover, it unifies security operations across clouds, automating incident response through intelligent analysis and compliance tools.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Develop test plan design and test case development for performance, load \& scale testing of NDH products.
* Define automation plan and test strategy within release timelines.
* End\-to\-end product quality ownership with all aspects of the test, automation, and delivery of the feature set at scale.
* Improve existing automated tests and overall automated test execution efficiency.
* Maintain a high overall quality index(QI) for the product/features at all times.
* Ability to delve deeper into debugging product issues with development engineers.
* Involve providing active feedback to improve the overall product experience.
* Debugging, filing bugs, and tracking them to closure.


**What Will You Bring**
* Minimum of 4\+yrs\-7yrs of experience in QA(System Test), Automation using Python (python preferred)
* BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent field.
* In depth working knowledge of Linux system interactions and Distributed Systems
* Deeper understanding of SW platform performance, load, scaling features.
* Deeper understanding of KS8 platform performance, load, scaling features.
* Experience with Python API test framework development.
* Working knowledge of virtualization \- VMware, KVM, or Hyper\-V
* Familiarity with version control systems such as GIT, build management tools, and Continuous Integration tools such as Jenkins/CircleCI
* Testing experience with monitoring/cloud products is a plus
* Detail\-oriented, self\-driven, and good verbal and written communication skills.


**Meet the hiring manager**
 Hello, this is Subu TK! I joined Nutanix almost 10 years ago and worked with several teams and roles during this time. I had been tech lead for the Nutanix Files QA team for several years, before taking over the responsibility of managing and owning the NDH QA team end\-to\-end. During my tenure at Nutanix, I got a wonderful opportunity to qualify/automate several key projects starting from NFS Server, SMB Server, RBAC, API, and Tiering. Also I was involved in defining CICD workflow and building tools to automate the entire process. Our team comprises versatile skill set expertise, full of energetic, and fun filled professional engineers. We are actively working on scaling up the NDH features and the Team. Looking forward to hiring a highly collaborative, skillful, curious, innovative and motivated engineer to automate/qualify product releases with very high quality to delight our customers.
   

  

**What The Team Says**
 Our team is a highly collaborative, skilled, and friendly group of engineers who foster a culture of learning, knowledge sharing and ownership. This creates an environment where any problem can be solved efficiently and effectively. Several innovative solutions are built in our automation code that brings out more efficiency to the overall qualification process. Along the way it provides a lot of renewed opportunity for professional development, growth and a sense of achievement.

title: Test Architect
description:
**Role:** 




 We're looking for a Test Architect to own our systems and integration testing strategy across complex, polyglot systems spanning C\+\+, Java and Python. Our test framework itself is written in Python, built on pytest, and we lean heavily on AI\-assisted development including Claude to build and extend it. You'll be the technical owner of that framework and the integration testing strategy behind it.
 



 This is a hands\-on architecture role, not a governance\-only position: you'll be writing Python/pytest day\-to\-day, building and evolving the framework, and working directly alongside engineers, while also acting as a client\-facing consultant understanding a stakeholder's technical challenges and driving the quality engineering roadmap that addresses them. Contract testing (e.g. Pact) is a useful tool in the kit, but it's a smaller part of the role than systems and integration testing
 



  





**Required Experience:** 



* 8\+ years as a Test Architect, Principal SDET, or senior test engineering leader, with proven ownership of systems/integration testing strategy for complex, distributed, polyglot systems.
* Strong hands\-on Python development with deep pytest expertise — building and maintaining test automation frameworks, not just writing test cases.
* Track record testing across service and process boundaries in polyglot environments spanning C\+\+, Java, and Python.
* Comfortable reading, and ideally writing, C\+\+ and Java alongside Python.
* Experience embedding automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, plus client\-facing consulting experience influencing senior stakeholders and shaping a test strategy roadmap.
* Open to work from Pune or Bengaluru location



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the systems and integration testing strategy across polyglot components (C\+\+, Java, Python), architecting suites that validate behaviour across service and process boundaries.
* Design, build and maintain the test automation framework in Python/pytest the backbone of how we test using AI\-assisted development tools (including Claude) to accelerate framework development and maintenance.
* Embed systems and integration tests into CI/CD pipelines, so breaking changes are caught before they reach production.
* Apply contract testing (e.g. Pact) selectively where it adds real value, as a complement to not a replacement for — the systems/integration test strategy.
* Partner directly with client engineering leaders to diagnose quality gaps, and propose and drive adoption of the tools, frameworks and practices that close them.
* Mentor and upskill engineers on Python/pytest test engineering and integration testing best practice, raising the quality bar across the wider team.
* Define and evolve the test automation roadmap for the engagement, balancing coverage, speed and maintainability.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Proven experience as a Test Architect, Principal SDET or similar, having designed and led systems/integration testing strategy for complex, distributed, polyglot systems.
* Strong, hands\-on Python skills with deep pytest expertise this is the language and framework the test suite is built on.
* A track record of testing across service and process boundaries in polyglot environments.
* Comfortable reading (and ideally writing) C\+\+ and Java, since the systems under test span both alongside Python.
* Enthusiasm for using AI coding assistants such as Claude to build and maintain test tooling and frameworks.
* Some exposure to contract testing (e.g. Pact) is a nice to have, and not the focus of the role.
* Experience embedding automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Confidence operating as a client\-facing consultant: comfortable influencing senior technical stakeholders and shaping strategy, not just executing against a backlog.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate testing strategy into business outcomes for both engineers and clients.
